newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1997 rapeseed output seen above 600,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1997 rapeseed output seen above 600,000 T.

text.p: Polish rapeseed output is expected to reach 600,000-660,000 tonnes this year, up from about 460,000 tonnes last year but still well below 1995 levels, PAP news agency said on Monday.
PAP quoted a report by a semi-independent Institute of Agriculture and Food Economy as saying its forecast assumed improved weather conditions this year and an increased use of fertilisers.

In 1996 rapeseed production fell 915,000 tonnes against 1995 as a result of a sharp drop in sown area to under 300,000 hectares, from more than 600,000 hectares, and a harsh winter which hurt crop yields.

The report predicted this year's sown area would remain unchanged from last year and expected the increase in output would be possible thanks to a forecast rise in crop yields to 20-22 quintals per hectare from last year's 16.6 quintals.
